ordinary_torch_reset.source:

        str x20,[sp,#16]

        mov w20,w1
        cmp w1,#1
        b.ne call_original
        ldr w8,[x19,#0x20]
        mov w9,#0x3002
        cmp w8,w9
        b.ne call_original
        mov w1,#0x107
    call_original:

        cmp w20,#1
        b.hi done
        ldr w8,[x19,#0x20]
        mov w9,#0x3002
        cmp w8,w9
        b.ne done
        mov w8,#7
        str w8,[x19,#0xb8]

        ldp x19,x30,[sp],#32

strength_setter.source:

        cbnz w0,done
        str w20,[x19,#0xb8]

        ldr x20,[sp,#16]
        ldp x19,x30,[sp],#32
        ret
    unsupported: mov w0,#-38; ret
    invalid: mov w0,#-22; ret
